title: A state tool silently ignores a documented argument position
query: run-state.py documents that --state-dir works before or after the subcommand. One of those positions writes somewhere else. Find which, and why.
oracle: The symptom is that a documented invocation lands in the wrong directory, which points at the filesystem rather than at argparse. The cause is a one-line interaction between a parent and child parser default, and it is not visible from reading either parser alone. R2 rather than R1 because nothing errors and nothing is printed -- you have to reason about argument precedence to see it.
